business_summary: Workout supplements brand offering pre-workout, creatine, and protein with the same formulations as expensive brands for half the cost.
stated_claims: We compete on price, not on marketing
Same formulations as the expensive brands for half the cost

relevant_tags.why: Core category of workout supplements (pre-workout, creatine, protein).
Fitness class attendees frequently use workout supplements.
Activewear shoppers overlap heavily with fitness and workout supplement consumers.

note_signals.why: Fitness-engaged shoppers will have a strong affinity for workout supplements.
Users actively spending on fitness and personal training are direct targets for supplements.
Audience is skeptical of unsubstantiated health claims, whereas these rely on value and formulation comparisons.

gate_reason: Product line and value proposition are clear. Price point and specific margin need clarification.
